when_edited: after the stage wrote PROTOCOL.json and its per-unit results
edit_scope: report rendering only: the audit-check key name used in REPORT_CN.md and the section label 'macro point estimates'
effect_on_numbers: no scoring, bootstrap, contrast or audit-check computation was touched; the bootstrap checkpoints and the aggregate CSVs were regenerated from the same stored replicates
disclosure: the recorded protocol hash is the version that produced the per-unit results; the current file differs only in report rendering. The protocol was deliberately NOT rewritten so the change stays visible.
